plan.decision: Does read4 help after normal startup global concurrency was adopted?
plan.host: local macOS arm64; Ubuntu not claimed
plan.workload: existing shop fixture,50 reads sharing one child and20 isolated writes;21 Fork children
measurements: sample SQL phase p50/p95 and >=100ms count
plan.exit: Report all five pairs including tails. A promising read4 candidate requires >=5% lower whole-wall median and wins >=4/5 pairs, with no correctness/cleanup failures. CPU or peak-RSS median increases >10% require explicit tradeoff review. Otherwise report mixed/no improvement; no automatic extra samples or adoption.
plan.limit: Descriptive one-host screening, not a confidence interval or product resource bound. Queue wait mechanism is unobserved.
plan.observer: caller timestamps only; no runtime queue/stack sampler
plan.intervention: guarded argv overlay; same binary validates all25 argv strings before read digit1->4;read1 executes same scan but leaves argv identical;SHOW verifies selected read value on root/children; no8MiB/read-group-independent global-cap changes
